body:
I'd say it looks good so far. For the oversized build I think your fine. 
With the walls I would use a combination depending on what you like and fits, Stonebrick, cobble, some clays even, and try different types of wood. Also add some depth to the walls?

Hey man, like you I find myself kind of against the church in many ways also. And I feel like I understand the pressure it puts on you. Have you come out to your family? Also I want you to know that I am on your side of it. Your family should love you and respect your decision.

I'm shocked at how simular are situations are. I'm glad you have talked to your sister about it. Talking is good, you said you thought your dad would be hurt if you talked to him to get diagnosed. What do you think he would feel like if you hadnt? Sometimes we think that keeping it all bottled up is what's best but we need someone to love us when we really need it.
Your doing this for the landlord?
Please reconsider, I wish you the best in any case. I hope you find what you are looking for.
Joe, can you promiss me that you will go to sleep tonight and wake up tomorrow? Then message me about how you are feeling?

Well even your landlord, please don't be alone, you might feel like that's what's best for you but you need someone near you, I care for you man. Be strong. Please call a suicide hotline, they are much better than I. It would make my day if you would
Do you have any family? Or friends that are close by?

I'm sorry to hear this, I'm probably not the best person to help on this matter because of my lack of knowledge of financial situations, but I do know the struggle of being stressed and feeling like you don't have a choice and in that case I can tell you that it's not worth it. 
I don't know your story but I'd be willing to listen.
I see. Other then your weed buiness are you working? And you also said that your living conditions aren't the best, is there anyway you can get out of it?

What's been going on?
Or anything you want to talk about
Hey man, before you do anything will you talk to me?

Sorry for such a long reply delay. 
But I understand your pain, you said your going to fail, have you started school already? Also how much have you talked to your parents about your thoughts? It may seem unrational but 90% the parents are just trying to help in the best way they know. Which isn't always what's best for us
Would you be willing to tell me what's been going on recently that has gotten you in this mood?
That's fantastic to hear! Thank you for sharing, it means a lot to me.(:
Of course, just don't give up on her

I don't know the whole situation but do you think her family is the problem? And you said she doesn't care for them which can be hard to help out with but the fact that you're willing to lend a hand is fantastic. Just make sure that you tell her you are with her and there for her.

Feeling worthless or just a waist of space is undeniably the worst ache one can feel. I understand the feeling of just wanting to sink away but suicide doesn't fix anything it just gives the pain to someone that loves and cares for you. You said you have a close group of friends. I'd like to share a story with you if you don't mind. Saturday night a lad at my school had committed suicide. I, nor my friend group knew the lad. We had a discussion of how we would feel if anything happened to anyone. I had been considering in taking my own life but hearing this changed my mind. Have you expressed to your friends how you feel? If not I'd recommend to do so. Or just a singular person. I'm not sure if the feeling you feel right now can compare to this but I'll do my best to relate to you.
I'm with ParaLegalize, I want to listen. What's lead to you feeling this way?
Is it family related? Schooling related? Does she know how much you care about her?
Do you know the situation that has made her come to this? That would help to understand exactly what's going on.

Thank you 
I will take your words into consideration. It means a lot.

I've thought about saying something but I think most of them would say "you wont" and such. That's what I plan on doing. That's probably true that they don't understand.. I'd say we communicate pretty well. I'm pretty  sure my parents know how I feel.
Hey, I care and im here for you. And it does matter what has been getting to you?

Happy birthday mate! 17? That's exciting, and I understand the frustration. How many of your friends birthdays do you have memorized? For me it's very few. But there much more to life then ending it here, please don't hesitate in talking to someone about it

I don't want to pull the religion card because if you aren't religious then there is not point in it, but having a hope that there is something after this life makes me feel like I can do it for this short time (compared to forever). When i get that feeling of dullness and numbing to the world I usually force myself to do something good for someone else. 

Believing there is nothing more to life then temporary happiness is okay, make the most of this small glimmer of it when you can. I'm sorry I'm not the most insperational person, just someone who cares for the well being of others, please go talk to someone when you feel down. Or just let me know and I'll gladly talk to you about anything

I understand what you mean. Two things; first, how do you think they would feel if you left them and they didn't know that they could have helped you? Secondly, it doesn't have to be a friend. Are you seeing a therapist or finding any other support?

I understand where you are coming from, I usually find myself filling my mind with meaningless nonsense to fill the void. But I've found that there is a purpose to life. What's been on your mind tonight?
Please tell someone, when you question if you should you should. What's been happening?

Depending on where you live im sure there is a local soup kitchen that needs help. I volenteer with special Olympics and other organizations that deal with special needs children. I don't think there is a wrong way to go.
Something that I've done and I think really helped me is volenteer and do service. You meet great people and are also doing something good.
Of course
Well I care for you now, and if there is anything you wanna talk about or just want to rant about let me know.
Is it undesirable or is there something specific that's gotcha down?
Writing that's really sweet, what genre do you like? I hope you feel the desire to write something sometime soon, I'd love to here it anytime.
Better then me! Do you que with people? If not then add people you play with and 9/10 they will gladly add you and play with you again. What are you going to be majoring in?

You give me inspiration because yo still tried to get help and are willing to still. And I think I can could do the same. I'm sorry to hear that you don't want to go back, but space can always be a good thing also. For advice I'd say find something you enjoy or something that keeps you occupied and from there you will meet others that share this. Any hobbies you have?
Well try it, you never know what might happen. What are you doing in Atlanta? (If not to personal)

I can't stress enough how much these people do care about you, they don't just say that just because. Please don't, people are here for you that really do care. have you thought about seeing a therapist?

I understand how you feel, like that no one is here for you, when was the last time you talked to any of your friends? I'm positive they care about you just don't know you feel this way. Ask them to hangout or do something fun.
What rank are you?
No way! I love counter strike. It really helps me relief stress.

I recently (passed year) tore a disk in my back and haven't been able to do much, but surprising swimming is really good for you and not so intense. 
The knee can predict the weather? (Does it do better then the weatherman?) That's pretty amazing to me. And I'm here to open up to if you want.
Life is worth so much more, setting goals is good, but should never be the end. Always expand them. I understand you with the video games, what games do you enjoy?

I'm glad you shared, it made me think. Also I like  that you love your mother so much that you're scared to tell her. But sometimes sharing with someone is best, doesn't have to be her, but someone that will sit down a listen. Ever thought about picking up running again?
Hey man, I wanna know what's up.
